name: Salep + Coconut + Poppy Seeds +  Almond
indication_description:
This is indicated in-
  • General debility
  • Nervous debility
  • Sexual debility
  • Oligospermia
  • Spermatorrhoea
pharmacology_description: This is a unique combination of Salep (Orchis latifolia), Coconut (Cocos nucifera), Poppy Seeds (Papaver somniferum), Mastic tree (Pistacia vera), Almond (Prunus amygdalus), Walnut (Juglans regia) and other natural ingredients. It is effective in the treatment of sexual debility, nervous debility, general debility, spermatorrhoea and oligospermia. This is also enhances retentive power.
dosage_description: 1 teaspoonful twice daily with milk or honey or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in the therapeutic dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
